review_scope: All tracked artifacts assessed; source/tests/docs read, images viewed, notebook code/output inspected, generated HTML parsed/compared. Lock,binary caches,coverage databases,source maps and final four CSS assets assessed structurally. Not every generated source byte read as prose; browser UI not exercised.
upstream_tests: 100 original tests passed in one run, including original notebook execution and membership integration; genuine Numba JIT enabled. Isolated registry creation test fails due to setup dependency.
controls: 15 unique finite cases cumulative;12 full-class cases repeated with genuine Numba. Remaining3 original AST/adapted controls retain earlier scope.
decision: Do not adopt production code. Numerical-vector algorithms are outside filesystem exact-identity domain; representative loss, stale matrix/mask, default tuning and failure restoration defects demonstrated. Useful lessons: independently validate group membership, state invalidation and exception restoration; green upstream tests insufficient.
license: Root MIT whole read; generated third-party theme notices retained, no code copied.
limits: Only macOS arm64 Python3.12 fresh dependency environment, not original lock/lower-version matrix.
